name: Bicycle floor pump
summary: Pushing the handle down drives a plunger through the barrel and forces air down the hose into the tyre, and the air cannot come back out when you pull the handle up again.

parts.name: Barrel
parts.role: The long tube the plunger slides in, where the air is squeezed.

parts.name: Handle and rod
parts.role: The T-handle you push and pull, on a rod that carries the plunger.

parts.name: Foot plate
parts.role: You stand on it to hold the pump still.

parts.name: Hose
parts.role: Carries the air from the barrel to the tyre.

parts.name: Pump head
parts.role: Clamps onto the tyre's valve stem with a flip lever.
